exercises.prompt: Describe a community event you have attended and what you liked about it.
Tell us about the last time you helped someone or took part in a community activity.
Some people prefer to volunteer in their community, while others prefer to donate money to charities. Which do you prefer, and why?
A company is considering giving employees one paid day each month to volunteer in their community. What are the advantages and disadvantages?

Your neighborhood is proposing a rule that every household must pay a monthly fee to support local community projects. I am a member of the neighborhood association. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
